title: CST-Bench: Benchmarking Counterfactual Spatial Transition Reasoning with Causal Transition On-Policy Self-Distillation
abstract: arXiv:2611.07541v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial reasoning is a fundamental capability of multimodal large language models (MLLMs), yet existing benchmarks mainly focus on static scene understanding. When objects are moved or swapped, models must infer not only spatial relations but also how interventions change the scene state. To address this problem, we introduce CST-Bench, a benchmark for counterfactual spatial reasoning. CST-Bench contains 7,082 examples covering 6 intervention types and 12 transformation operators, with dense causal annotations including intervention sources, affected relations, expected effects, invariant relations, and metric changes. We benchmark general-purpose MLLMs on CST-Bench and further compare post-training strategies on CST-Bench and standard spatial benchmarks. translated_title: CST-Bench：基于因果转变在线策略自蒸馏的反事实空间转变推理基准测试
translated_abstract: 空间推理是多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的一项基础能力，然而现有基准主要集中于静态场景理解。当物体被移动或交换时，模型不仅要推断空间关系，还必须推断干预操作如何改变场景状态。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CST-Bench，一个用于反事实空间推理的基准。CST-Bench包含7,082个样本，涵盖6种干预类型和12种变换算子，并带有密集的因果标注，包括干预来源、受影响的关系、预期效果、不变关系以及度量变化。我们在CST-Bench上对通用MLLM进行了基准测试，并进一步在CST-Bench和标准空间基准上比较了多种后训练策略。结果表明，对普通空间推理有效的方法在反事实干预下仍可能失效。我们进一步将反事实空间推理形式化为因果状态转变问题……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了反事实空间推理基准CST-Bench（包含7,082个样本、6种干预类型、12种变换算子及密集因果标注），揭示现有MLLM在物体被干预移动或交换时空间推理仍会失效，并提出因果转变在线策略自蒸馏方法来提升反事实空间推理能力。
